In a study about the hiring process of a company, it is of interest to study the relationship
between the outcome of a job interview (hired or not), and the age and gender of the individuals.
In particular, the outcome takes value 1 if the person has been hired and 0 otherwise; the age
variable is expressed in years; and the gender variable takes value 1 if the individual is a man
and 0 otherwise. Fitting a logistic regression produces the following result:
